# Lab 15.2: Visual Graph Modeler

## What We Are Going to Do
Build the same graph in the console with the visual graph modeler instead of writing DDL.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Open the modeler.** In Explorer, click **⋮** on `lab15 → Create property graph`, or **+ → Graph**.

2. **[Console] Add nodes.** Drag `Person` and `Account` onto the canvas. Set the labels to `Person` and `Account`. Choose which columns become properties.

3. **[Console] Add edges.** Drag `PersonOwnAccount` and connect `Person → Account`; set the label `Owns`. Drag `AccountTransferAccount` and connect `Account → Account`; set the label `Transfers`.

4. **[Console] Review the generated DDL.** Click **View DDL**. It matches the statement from Lab 15.1. Save it as `lab15.FinGraphVisual`.

5. **[SQL] Confirm both graphs work.**
